package.description: An agent runtime designed for tool-driven loop engineering.

en-US.description: An agent runtime designed for tool-driven loop engineering.
en-US.longDescription: Bumblehive Desktop is an optional reference application built with the Bumblehive Python SDK. It shows how Runtime, tools, and sessions can be combined into a complete product: manage model calls, the Agent Loop, and resource lifecycles through Runtime; give an Agent Python functions, built-in tools, or MCP servers; add streaming events, conversation history, persisted sessions, Skills, and observability hooks when needed.
en-US.name: BumbleHive

zh-CN.description: 面向工具驱动循环工程设计的 Agent 运行时。
zh-CN.longDescription: Bumblehive Desktop 是使用 Bumblehive Python SDK 构建的可选参考应用，展示了如何把 Runtime、工具和会话能力组合成完整产品：通过 Runtime 管理模型调用、Agent 循环与资源生命周期；为 Agent 提供 Python 函数、内置工具或 MCP 服务器；按需接入流式事件、对话历史、持久化会话、Skills 与可观测性钩子。
